grammar.pattern: 多久 / 为什么 / 怎么样 / 怎样
grammar.purpose: Ask for duration, reason or manner
grammar.explanation: 多久 asks duration, not a clock time: 坐车要多久 versus 几点出发. 为什么 asks a reason. 怎么样 often asks an evaluation or condition: 味道怎么样. 怎样 can ask the manner of doing something: 怎样去, and can also ask an evaluation. Put the question word where the missing information belongs; these questions do not need 吗. A reason may use 因为, taught more fully later; a simple 因为 clause is a useful recognition answer here.

examples.zh: 坐车要多久？二十分钟。几点出发？六点。
examples.py: zuò chē yào duō jiǔ ? èr shí fēn zhōng . jǐ diǎn chū fā ? liù diǎn .
examples.en: How long by vehicle? Twenty minutes. What time do we leave? Six.

examples.zh: 为什么选这里？这里安静。味道怎么样？不错。
examples.py: wèi shén me xuǎn zhè lǐ ? zhè lǐ ān jìng . wèi dao zěn me yàng ? bù cuò .
examples.en: Why choose here? It is quiet. How does it taste? Good.

examples.zh: 怎样去？坐车到大学站，再走五分钟。
examples.py: zěn yàng qù ? zuò chē dào dà xué zhàn , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng .
examples.en: How do we get there? Ride to University Station, then walk five minutes.

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 吗 to this question-word duration question.

grammar.pattern: 什么时候 / 什么样 / 为什么 / 怎么样 / 怎样
grammar.purpose: Choose the information a question requests
grammar.explanation: 什么时候 asks when; 什么样 asks kind or characteristics; 为什么 asks why; 怎么样/怎样 ask a condition, evaluation or way. Use context to disambiguate 怎样. 什么样的饭馆 is a kind question, not a request for the restaurant name. A preference answer is one person’s view and does not establish a universal quality ranking.

examples.zh: 什么时候去？今晚。想去什么样的饭馆？安静一点的。
examples.py: shén me shí hou qù ? jīn wǎn . xiǎng qù shén me yàng de fàn guǎn ? ān jìng yī diǎn de .
examples.en: When shall we go? Tonight. What kind of restaurant? A somewhat quieter one.

examples.zh: 为什么不叫外卖？想出去走走。这里服务怎么样？很热情。
examples.py: wèi shén me bù jiào wài mài ? xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu . zhè lǐ fú wù zěn me yàng ? hěn rè qíng .
examples.en: Why not order delivery? I want a walk. How is the service here? Welcoming.

examples.zh: 你认为怎样去合适？坐车吧。
examples.py: nǐ rèn wéi zěn yàng qù hé shì ? zuò chē ba .
examples.en: What way of getting there do you think is suitable? Let us take a vehicle.

commonMistakes.why: 什么时候 asks a time; 什么样 asks a kind or characteristic.

dialogue.title: Why this place?
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find their reasons and the trade-off they accept.

lines.zh: 晚餐去什么样的饭馆？快餐也可以。
lines.py: wǎn cān qù shén me yàng de fàn guǎn ? kuài cān yě kě yǐ .
lines.en: What kind of restaurant for dinner? Fast food is an option too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 午餐吃了快餐，昨天还吃方便面。今天想慢慢吃。
lines.py: wǔ cān chī le kuài cān , zuó tiān hái chī fāng biàn miàn . jīn tiān xiǎng màn màn chī .
lines.en: I had fast food for lunch and instant noodles yesterday. Today I want to eat slowly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 为什么不叫外卖？在家很方便。
lines.py: wèi shén me bù jiào wài mài ? zài jiā hěn fāng biàn .
lines.en: Why not order delivery? It is convenient at home.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我想出去走走，也想找安静的地方聊天。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu , yě xiǎng zhǎo ān jìng de dì fāng liáo tiān .
lines.en: I want to go out for a walk and find a quiet place to chat.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你的看法是什么？这家怎么样？
lines.py: nǐ de kàn fa shì shén me ? zhè jiā zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: What is your view? How about this place?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我认为合适。饭馆不大，桌子和碗很干净，服务也热情。
lines.py: wǒ rèn wéi hé shì . fàn guǎn bù dà , zhuō zi hé wǎn hěn gān jìng , fú wù yě rè qíng .
lines.en: I think it is suitable. The restaurant is small, its tables and bowls are clean, and the service is welcoming.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 味道怎么样？比如这个鸡蛋辣吗？
lines.py: wèi dao zěn me yàng ? bǐ rú zhè gè jī dàn là ma ?
lines.en: How does the food taste? Is this egg dish spicy, for example?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不辣。我们的口味不同，可以点不同的菜。
lines.py: bù là . wǒ men de kǒu wèi bù tóng , kě yǐ diǎn bù tóng de cài .
lines.en: Not spicy. Our tastes differ, so we can order different dishes.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 有什么好处和坏处？顾客多，要等多久？
lines.py: yǒu shén me hǎo chù hé huài chù ? gù kè duō , yào děng duō jiǔ ?
lines.en: What advantages and drawbacks are there? There are many customers; how long is the wait?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好处是离家近，坏处是要等二十分钟。我对菜满意，对等很久有点不满。
lines.py: hǎo chù shì lí jiā jìn , huài chù shì yào děng èr shí fēn zhōng . wǒ duì cài mǎn yì , duì děng hěn jiǔ yǒu diǎn bù mǎn .
lines.en: It is close to home, but the drawback is a twenty-minute wait. I am satisfied with the food but a little dissatisfied with a long wait.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 怎样去？什么时候出发？
lines.py: zěn yàng qù ? shén me shí hou chū fā ?
lines.en: How do we get there? When shall we leave?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 坐车十分钟，再走五分钟。六点出发吧。选这里的原因是方便聊天。
lines.py: zuò chē shí fēn zhōng , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng . liù diǎn chū fā ba . xuǎn zhè lǐ de yuán yīn shì fāng biàn liáo tiān .
lines.en: Ride ten minutes, then walk five. Let us leave at six. We choose here because it is convenient for chatting.
lines.speaker: b

choices: A quiet, clean place suited to chatting
questions.answer: A quiet, clean place suited to chatting

Does satisfaction with the food erase the wait complaint?
choices: No, the two refer to different aspects
Yes, every aspect must have one rating

reading.title: Separate the reasons
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read to distinguish travel time, waiting time and taste.

lines.zh: 午餐我吃快餐，昨天吃方便面。今晚不想叫外卖，想和朋友出去聊天。
lines.py: wǔ cān wǒ chī kuài cān , zuó tiān chī fāng biàn miàn . jīn wǎn bù xiǎng jiào wài mài , xiǎng hé péng you chū qù liáo tiān .
lines.en: I had fast food for lunch and instant noodles yesterday. Tonight I do not want delivery; I want to go out and chat with a friend.

lines.zh: 我问想去什么样的饭馆，朋友说安静一点的，碗和桌子也应该干净。
lines.py: wǒ wèn xiǎng qù shén me yàng de fàn guǎn , péng you shuō ān jìng yī diǎn de , wǎn hé zhuō zi yě yīng gāi gān jìng .
lines.en: I asked what kind of restaurant; my friend said a somewhat quieter one with clean bowls and tables.

lines.zh: 我们认为这家合适。选择它的原因是方便聊天，服务顾客也很热情。
lines.py: wǒ men rèn wéi zhè jiā hé shì . xuǎn zé tā de yuán yīn shì fāng biàn liáo tiān , fú wù gù kè yě hěn rè qíng .
lines.en: We think this place is suitable. We choose it because it is convenient for chatting, and it serves customers warmly.

lines.zh: 我们的看法不完全一样，口味也不同。比如我不想吃辣的鸡蛋，她想吃别的菜。
lines.py: wǒ men de kàn fa bù wán quán yī yàng , kǒu wèi yě bù tóng . bǐ rú wǒ bù xiǎng chī là de jī dàn , tā xiǎng chī bié de cài .
lines.en: Our views are not entirely the same, and our tastes differ. For example, I do not want spicy eggs, while she wants another dish.

lines.zh: 这家的味道不错，我对菜很满意。好处是离家近，坏处是顾客多，要等二十分钟。
lines.py: zhè jiā de wèi dao bù cuò , wǒ duì cài hěn mǎn yì . hǎo chù shì lí jiā jìn , huài chù shì gù kè duō , yào děng èr shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: The food tastes good and I am satisfied with it. It is close to home, but the drawback is many customers and a twenty-minute wait.

lines.zh: 等了很久，我有点不满，但没有说菜不好吃。评价要讲清楚是哪一件事。
lines.py: děng le hěn jiǔ , wǒ yǒu diǎn bù mǎn , dàn méi yǒu shuō cài bù hǎo chī . píng jià yào jiǎng qīng chǔ shì nǎ yī jiàn shì .
lines.en: I am a little dissatisfied with waiting a long time, but did not say the food was bad. An evaluation should specify which aspect.

lines.zh: 怎样去？坐车十分钟，再走五分钟。什么时候出发？我们定六点。
lines.py: zěn yàng qù ? zuò chē shí fēn zhōng , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng . shén me shí hou chū fā ? wǒ men dìng liù diǎn .
lines.en: How do we get there? Ride ten minutes, then walk five. When do we leave? We decided on six.

lines.zh: 要多久可以坐下，还要问店里。路上十五分钟，不是已经有了座位。
lines.py: yào duō jiǔ kě yǐ zuò xià , hái yào wèn diàn lǐ . lù shàng shí wǔ fēn zhōng , bù shì yǐ jīng yǒu le zuò wèi .
lines.en: We still need to ask the restaurant how long until we can sit. Fifteen minutes of travel does not mean a seat is already available.

questions.q: What is the writer careful to separate?
What is the total travel time?
Does leaving at six prove sitting at six fifteen?
choices: Yes, travel and waiting are identical

lines.en: I asked what kind of restaurant; my friend said a somewhat quieter one with clean bowls and tables.

lines.zh: 这家的味道不错，我对菜很满意。好处是离家近，【坏处】是顾客多，要等二十分钟。
lines.py: zhè jiā de wèi dao bù cuò , wǒ duì cài hěn mǎn yì . hǎo chù shì lí jiā jìn , huài chù shì gù kè duō , yào děng èr shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: The food tastes good and I am satisfied with it. It is close to home, but the drawback is many customers and a twenty-minute wait.
